name: Stonetalon Standstill
summary: At Mystral Lake, befouled water spirits have halted Horde supply transports on the way to Stonetalon. Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post sends you to clear the hostile elementals and scout a night elf gazebo overlooking Silverwind Refuge.

sections.title: A Choked Supply Route
sections.body: The Horde needs lumber, supplies, and messengers to travel between Ashenvale and the Stonetalon Mountains. The Talondeep Path carries them past Mystral Lake’s western shore. Hostile water elementals have stopped travel and battered the supply caravans. Mastok Wrilehiss calls for action to reopen the route before the Horde’s supply lines collapse.

sections.title: The Corrupted Waters
sections.body: Water elementals in Mystral Lake have become befouled, aggressive, and unpredictable. They attack those who take the nearby trails. You are sent to cull them and defeat the greater spirit Tideress so the area may become safer. What has tainted the lake’s spirits remains unknown amid the turmoil in Ashenvale’s sacred groves.

sections.title: Eyes Across the Water
sections.body: A night elf gazebo stands on Mystral Lake’s central island, with a clear view across the water to Silverwind Refuge. Horde scouts are sent to assess whether it could serve as a forward observation post. From there, Splintertree’s commanders could watch nearby Alliance movements without being detected.

faq.q: What is causing the standstill near Stonetalon?
faq.answer: Befouled water elementals in Mystral Lake have turned violent and attack travelers on the nearby Talondeep Path. Their attacks have halted supply transports between Ashenvale and the Stonetalon Mountains.
Mastok Wrilehiss, an orc at Splintertree Post in eastern Ashenvale, orders you to clear the elementals and scout the Alliance position.

faq.q: Why scout the gazebo in the middle of Mystral Lake?
faq.answer: The gazebo on Mystral Lake’s central island offers a view across the water toward the nearby night elf settlement of Silverwind Refuge. Mastok wants it assessed as a hidden observation post for watching enemy movements.
The Talondeep Path is the mountain trail connecting southwestern Ashenvale to the Stonetalon Mountains. It runs past Mystral Lake’s western shore.

faq.q: Why are the water elementals in Mystral Lake befouled?
faq.answer: The cause of the water elementals’ corruption is unknown. Turmoil in Ashenvale has disrupted the lake, leaving its spirits hostile to outsiders.

faq.q: Which Alliance outpost is being watched from the gazebo?
aliases: what alliance base near mystral lake
faq.answer: The gazebo overlooks Silverwind Refuge, a night elf settlement just north of the lake. Sentinels there defend Ashenvale against the Horde’s lumber-harvesting operations.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you know Splintertree Post depends on open supply routes. Keeping the Talondeep Path clear maintains communication and trade with Stonetalon.
As a shaman, you recognize the water elementals’ twisted state as a sign of deep elemental disharmony in Ashenvale’s ancient forests.
As an orc, you know the Horde relies on Ashenvale’s timber and trails to supply its settlements. The disruption of mountain supply lines cannot stand.
